evals.prompt: Our pytest suite is flat and has a lot of tiny tests. Propose a safe first refactor without breaking existing CI commands.
evals.expected_output: A bounded proposal that names the UT value gate, recommends pruning-first when tiny tests are low-value, preserves explicit CI/path entrypoints, and lists deletion/consolidation candidates before any layout work.

evals.prompt: Review these unit tests and identify which ones are low-signal versus contract tests worth keeping.
evals.expected_output: Aggressive classification by behavior value, refactor tolerance, public contract protection, and default delete/merge/reclassify decisions for tests that cannot prove a real behavior or failure mode.

evals.prompt: Help me reorganize test fixtures for a Python project with repeated dense dictionaries in many tests.
evals.expected_output: A recommendation to introduce explicit factories/builders only after real duplication appears, while rejecting fixture extraction that hides behavior or helps low-value tests survive.
